To integrate a vector-valued function, we integrate each component separately:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int ⟨{3}^{t},\,{csc}^{2}⁡t⟩\text{d}t & =⟨\int {3}^{t}\,\text{d}t,\int {csc}^{2}⁡t\,\text{d}t⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{{3}^{t}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡3}+{c}_{1},\,-\operatorname{cot}⁡t+{c}_{2}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{{3}^{t}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡3},\,-\operatorname{cot}⁡t⟩+⟨{c}_{1},\,{c}_{2}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{{3}^{t}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡3},\,-\operatorname{cot}⁡t⟩+C\end{aligned}
$$
